```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(ggplot2)
library(resrepo)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- path_resrepo("results/s03_malagasy_pca/")
```

# Load gt

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
```

# Impute

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_merged, method = "random")
```

# PCA

```{r}
random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_merged) #- this works

#big_random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(imputed_data)
#auto_pca <- gt_pca_autoSVD(imputed_data) # there's still an error here...
```

Error with autoSVD - Error: Incompatibility between dimensions. 'infos.chr' and 'cols_along(G)' should have the same length.

```{r}
#Read in Pierron Malagasy metadata
pop_table <- read.table(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2","FID","Population","V5","V6","V7")

#Remove the "RR"
malagasy_merged$id <- sub("RR.*", "", malagasy_merged$id)

#Find Malagasy entries 
pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% malagasy_merged$id & pop_table$V5 =="Madagascar")

#match up the ID's with pop table metadata
matching_m <- match(malagasy_merged$id, pop_table_sub$IID)

malagasy_merged$Population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], malagasy_merged$Population)


#pcs <- as.data.frame(big_random_pca$u)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca$u)
variance <- round((random_pca$d^2/sum(random_pca$d^2))*100,2)

ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_merged$Population, colour = malagasy_merged$Population, shape = malagasy_merged$Population, fill = malagasy_merged$Population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = paste0("PC 1: ",variance[1],"%"), y = paste0("PC 2: ",variance[2],"%"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))#+ geom_text(aes(label=malagasy_merged$id))

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)

```

Problem: we'll never get a sensible PCA if we leave really close relatives in, but we need to keep close relatives because consanguinity is so common? I think we need to remove the close relatives

# Create a dataset with more stringent relatedness

```{r}
madagascar <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full_cleaned.gt"))
madagascar_p <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Pierron_Malagasy_clean.gt"))

madagascar <- madagascar %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar, kings_threshold = 0.0442)
madagascar_p <- madagascar_p %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m_p <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar_p, kings_threshold = 0.0442)

#find relatives
madagascar <- madagascar %>% ungroup()
madagascar_p <- madagascar_p %>% ungroup()

madagascar_low_rel <- madagascar %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
madagascar_p_low_rel<- madagascar_p %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m_p$id & individual_report_m_p$to_keep == TRUE)

#merge again
#malagasy_low_rel <- rbind(madagascar_low_rel,madagascar_p_low_rel,as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE, quiet = FALSE, backingfile = path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin"))

malagasy_low_rel <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.gt"))

# impute 
malagasy_low_rel <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_low_rel, method = "random")

# ld clumping
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_low_rel, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)

#remove out of LD
malagasy_low_rel <- malagasy_low_rel %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```

# PCA 

```{r}
#PCA
random_pca2 <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_low_rel)
#Error in if (any_near0(ms$scale)) stop2(MSG_ZERO_SCALE) : 
#  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

#big_random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(imputed_data)

```


```{r}

#Remove the "RR"
malagasy_low_rel$id <- sub("RR.*", "", malagasy_low_rel$id)

#Find Malagasy entries 
pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% malagasy_low_rel$id) #& pop_table$V5 =="Madagascar"something wrong here


#match up the ID's with pop table metadata
matching_m <- match(malagasy_low_rel$id, pop_table_sub$IID)


malagasy_low_rel$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], malagasy_low_rel$population)


#pcs <- as.data.frame(big_random_pca$u)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca2$u)
variance <- round((random_pca2$d^2/sum(random_pca2$d^2))*100,2)


ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_low_rel$population, colour = malagasy_low_rel$population, shape = malagasy_low_rel$population, fill = malagasy_low_rel$population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = paste0("PC 1: ",variance[1],"%") , y =  paste0("PC 2: ",variance[2],"%"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))#+ geom_text(aes(label=malagasy_low_rel$id))


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca_king_0442.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
```

# With original relatedness filtering

```{r}
madagascar <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full_cleaned.gt"))
madagascar_p <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Pierron_Malagasy_clean.gt"))

individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar, kings_threshold = 0.0442)
individual_report_m_p <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar_p, kings_threshold = 0.0442)

madagascar_low_rel <- madagascar %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
madagascar_p_low_rel<- madagascar_p %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m_p$id & individual_report_m_p$to_keep == TRUE)

#merge again
#malagasy_low_rel_original <- rbind(madagascar_low_rel,madagascar_p_low_rel,as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE, quiet = FALSE, backingfile = path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original"))

malagasy_low_rel <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.gt"))

# impute 
malagasy_low_rel <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_low_rel, method = "random")

# ld clumping
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_low_rel, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)

#remove out of LD
malagasy_low_rel <- malagasy_low_rel %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))

#PCA
random_pca3 <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_low_rel)

#Remove the "RR"
malagasy_low_rel$id <- sub("RR.*", "", malagasy_low_rel$id)

#Find Malagasy entries 
pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% malagasy_low_rel$id) #& pop_table$V5 =="Madagascar"something wrong here


#match up the ID's with pop table metadata
matching_m <- match(malagasy_low_rel$id, pop_table_sub$IID)


malagasy_low_rel$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], malagasy_low_rel$population)


#pcs <- as.data.frame(big_random_pca$u)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca3$u)
variance <- round((random_pca3$d^2/sum(random_pca3$d^2))*100,2)


ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_low_rel$population, colour = malagasy_low_rel$population, shape = malagasy_low_rel$population, fill = malagasy_low_rel$population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = paste0("PC 1: ",variance[1],"%") , y =  paste0("PC 2: ",variance[2],"%"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))#+ geom_text(aes(label=malagasy_low_rel$id))

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca_king_0442_original_filtering.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
```
